kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنفضح (form VII)
# أَنْفَضِحُ (ʔanfaḍiḥu) /ʔan.fa.dˤi.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَضَحَ (infaḍaḥa)
# أَنْفَضِحَ (ʔanfaḍiḥa) /ʔan.fa.dˤi.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَضَحَ (infaḍaḥa)
# أَنْفَضِحْ (ʔanfaḍiḥ) /ʔan.fa.dˤiħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْفَضَحَ (infaḍaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
